decision.reason: The exact 672-dispatch contraction and target-host/complete-wall measurements improve, but the predeclared gate also requires the intended fused family and target kernel sum to improve. The family regresses 4.202% and target/complete kernels regress 0.351%/0.268%, so runtime ownership is removed before natural25 rather than moving the gate after measurement.
decision.reopen_condition: Reopen only with a materially different algorithm or owner that improves the dependent family, target kernels, target host, and complete marked wall on W7900.
